body:
The issue isn't with the `max_size` we get from `c->get_combined_maximum_size()` but rather the one given to it at the end of the layout phase here:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/321b8c944fa32ee94eef44a56925105d7091be03/scene/gui/box_container.cpp#L275-L281
The problem we are encountering is that the 22.33 height that the MSDF font needs (in this example case) gets rounded down to 22 (since we use ints everywhere in layouts for some reason), and since the `Label` doesn't have `SIZE_EXPAND`, it will be given 22 as a max size (lines above), which will then make it not render.

If the user gives the `Label` a max size too small for its font, that's a user error, and that not rendering text is a limitation of MSDF fonts. 
Furthermore, the fix you propose would have minimum size take priority over maximum size, which is the opposite of the decision (I) made during the max size PR, which is that it takes priority over minimum size, not the other way around.
